entities.name: DNN
entities.description: Data Network Name information element that may be included by the UE under specific conditions.

entities.name: Request type
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of request being made by the UE.

entities.name: Payload container type
entities.description: Information element specifying the type of payload container.

entities.name: DNN inclusion conditions
entities.description: Conditions under which the UE may include the DNN IE: Request type set to initial request, existing PDU session, or MA PDU request; Payload container type set to N1 SM information; UE not registered for onboarding services in SNPN.

entities.name: UE not registered for onboarding services in SNPN
entities.description: Property indicating the UE is not registered for onboarding services in a Standalone Non-Public Network.

relations.description: Inclusion of the DNN IE is guarded by specific conditions related to other IEs and UE registration status.
DNN inclusion condition requires Request type IE to be set to initial request, existing PDU session, or MA PDU request.
DNN inclusion condition requires Payload container type IE to be set to N1 SM information.
DNN inclusion condition requires that the UE is not registered for onboarding services in SNPN.
